items.summary: XSR-754 delivers the preinstalled protected helper, independent publisher verification, Windows/Unix immutable slots, offline recovery, activation, rollback, restart and idle-safe UI progress. XSR-755 adds signed content-defined file deltas, full fallback and authenticated history publishing while preserving the v1 release envelope. Managed interruption and actual loopback HTTP regressions pass. Windows Setup creates administrator-owned objects before copy; Launcher Build validates installed-helper admission and native transactions on six RIDs, including publisher-generated delta consumption. Physical acceptance remains separate; legacy staged helpers stay refused.
remaining: Exercise physical power-loss and replacement races on all three operating systems; assigned to Dots because the user has no available devices.

items.summary: The user has no Apple Developer account and supplied no Windows publisher identity; repository GPG verification does not provide OS publisher trust.
remaining: Sign with production Authenticode and Developer ID identities, notarize macOS artifacts, and retain SmartScreen and Gatekeeper physical-device observations.

items.summary: At baseline 565e5143, bounded Function ABI/compiler points, Event/Intent, caption/text-card State adapters and the XSR-790 Host API are implemented. Host negotiation, typed payloads, streams/credits, health, unregistration and supervision are no longer declaration-only gaps. Additional Function shapes and real plugin acceptance remain distinct from the external Plugin SDK/engine/UI contracts.
remaining: Define and deliver additional Function ABI shapes, semantic call binding and hook/visual adapters with cancellation and retired-session parity.

Complete external Plugin SDK, execution-engine, package/UI IR and arbitrary interactive New UI contracts in their owning repository, then review real plugin lifecycle and long-running failure evidence.

items.summary: At baseline 565e5143, graphs, mod search/enablement/trash/restore, screenshot previews, XSR-759 server editing/status/Join, XSR-760 selected-file MRPack export and XSR-758/774 reversible resource-pack/shader updates have working consumers. Mod and bulk update, world-specific operations and screenshot editing remain incomplete.
remaining: Add actual mod updates, selection/bulk updates, changelog and one multi-item rollback transaction.
Add world/datapack/version/size/last-played/backup/lock workflows and richer screenshot metadata/crop; current directory and preview operations do not substitute for them.
Review physical shared-directory, cancellation, interruption and interaction evidence for the delivered management operations.

items.summary: Several bounded hot paths are covered. Early usable Splash/presentation instrumentation, OS memory-pressure and measured GPU image budgeting plus remaining background admission are separate implementation gaps; physical drag, animation, scroll and 8h KPI evidence remains unaccepted.
remaining: Deliver an early usable Splash, real initialization/error stages and first-presentation instrumentation.
Integrate OS memory pressure, measured GPU image budgeting and remaining background-work yielding; pixel charge is not measured native/GPU residency.
Profile physical drag, animation and scroll tails and collect controlled idle/game resource and long-running evidence.
